result.title: Data-Quality-Aware Fundus Classification with Anatomy-Guided Glaucoma Assessment and Cross-Dataset Evaluation
result.summary: Background: Deep learning fundus classifiers often perform well internally, but duplicated images, inconsistent labels, acquisition differences and poor threshold transfer can undermine their reliability. We assess nine-class classifiers beyond internal accuracy, using a data audit, frozen-model external evaluation and an anatomy-guided specialist. Methods: Nine-class experts (ConvNeXt-Small, EfficientNetV2-Small, DenseNet169) were trained with three seeds. Auditing 5,318 images for exact duplicates and cross-label conflicts removed 464 conflict groups (942 images) and six same-label copies, leaving 4,370 images. An anatomy-guided glaucoma specialist read disc-centred crops with vessel and disc/cup segmentation maps, plus cup-to-disc features. Frozen models were evaluated on RFMiD and JSIEC, and a prespecified comparison on REFUGE was replicated on ORIGA, G1020 and PAPILA. Results: ConvNeXt-Small reached an internal accuracy of 0.910, macro-F1 of 0.917 and AUC of 0.982; disc and cup Dice scores were 0.966 and 0.915. Across seeds, the fixed anatomy-guided mix left internal accuracy unchanged relative to equal soft voting (-0.001) but raised mean external closed-set accuracy by 4.9 percentage points on RFMiD (positive in two of three seeds) and 2.3 on JSIEC. On REFUGE (800 photographs) it improved balanced accuracy by 7.4 percentage points (95% CI 5.1 to 9.5), and by 2.1 on ORIGA, with positive gains on G1020 and PAPILA. Thresholds transferred poorly (REFUGE sensitivity 0.950, specificity 0.411). Conclusions: Retinal classifiers should be judged by data-quality auditing, anatomy-informed modelling and multi-cohort evaluation. Anatomy-guided fusion improved transfer at no internal cost, but gains varied by cohort and thresholds did not transfer, so internal metrics alone do not establish reliable performance.

AI.brief_summary: 针对九类眼底图像分类，通过重复/冲突标签数据审计、解剖引导的青光眼专家融合模型与多队列冻结外部评测来检验模型可靠性。
AI.relevance_reason: 这是一项医学影像分类的应用与评测工作，核心是数据清洗、分割图特征融合和跨数据集迁移，未涉及推理期视觉信息的内部表示、证据获取或停止决策；阈值迁移不佳属常规校准问题，缺少可供 LVR 核查的具体方法线索。
